a: Nigeria is often described by North, South, East, West regions with diverse cultures.
Nigeria has 36 states plus the Federal Capital Territory (Abuja).
The Niger and Benue rivers meet at the Lokoja confluence.
Nollywood is Nigeria's film industry, one of the world's largest by volume.
Afrobeats is a popular contemporary West African music genre with global reach.
ISO currency code for the Naira is NGN.
Harmattan is a dry, dusty season wind affecting parts of West Africa.
Nigeria borders Benin, Niger, Chad, and Cameroon.
Yankari is a well-known national park/game reserve in Nigeria.
Zuma Rock is a famous monolithic rock near Abuja.
WAT (UTC+1) is Nigeria's time zone year-round.
